title: What percentage of players born before 1986 who weigh under 130 pounds and
question: What percentage of players born before 1986 who weigh under 130 pounds and prefer their left foot have an overall rating above 70? Also, name the league that hosted the most matches in the 2015/2016 season.

prediction.sql:
WITH pct AS (
  SELECT 
    CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN pa.XCL_132 > 70 THEN p.XCL_122 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(DISTINCT p.XCL_122) AS percentage
  FROM Player p
  INNER JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON p.XCL_122 = pa.XCL_130
  WHERE SUBSTRING(p.XCL_125, 1, 4) < '1986'
    AND p.XCL_127 < 130
    AND pa.XCL_134 = 'left'
),
top_league AS (
  SELECT l.XCL_005 AS league_name
  FROM League l
  INNER JOIN Match m ON l.XCL_003 = m.XCL_008
  WHERE m.XCL_009 = '2015/2016'
  GROUP BY l.XCL_005
  ORDER BY COUNT(m.XCL_006) DESC
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT pct.percentage, top_league.league_name
FROM pct
CROSS JOIN top_league

compiled_semantic_plan.candidate_sql:
WITH pct AS (
  SELECT 
    CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN pa.XCL_132 > 70 THEN p.XCL_122 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(DISTINCT p.XCL_122) AS percentage
  FROM Player p
  INNER JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON p.XCL_122 = pa.XCL_130
  WHERE SUBSTRING(p.XCL_125, 1, 4) < '1986'
    AND p.XCL_127 < 130
    AND pa.XCL_134 = 'left'
),
top_league AS (
  SELECT l.XCL_005 AS league_name
  FROM League l
  INNER JOIN Match m ON l.XCL_003 = m.XCL_008
  WHERE m.XCL_009 = '2015/2016'
  GROUP BY l.XCL_005
  ORDER BY COUNT(m.XCL_006) DESC
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT pct.percentage, top_league.league_name
FROM pct
CROSS JOIN top_league
